section_summary.extract_value: Study 3 describes a methodological revision to the BAS-2 instrument, where Item 8 was modified from 'I walk holding my head high and smiling' to 'I hold my head high and smile' to be more inclusive of individuals with physical disabilities. The study re-examined the BAS-2's factor structure, internal consistency reliability, and correlations with BMI using a community participant sample, comparing results to Study 2 data to assess whether the item modification compromised the instrument's validity.
